goal: Research and rank ICLR-suitable AI/ML topic directions for SLM_PAPER under strict compute/dependency constraints
user_query: use this repo and find 30 topics, refute/discuss, align in loops, and give best topic with constraints

steps.description: ANALYSIS: read repository strategy docs to ground topic proposals in existing results and constraints (public benchmarks, ICLR target, SLM focus)
ANALYSIS: generate 30 candidate topics in technical GenAI/SLM/VLM inference space and hard-filter by no-LLM-API + no-GPU constraints
ANALYSIS: run 20 iterative alignment loops (feasibility, novelty, reproducibility, ICLR fit) with refute-vs-support scoring to reduce to strongest shortlist
DOCUMENTATION: write a ranked recommendation report with best topic, rationale, and explicit gate conditions to reach top-20 shortlist
